data.animaCaption: Seated at a wrought-iron garden table beneath blooming citrus trees, she raises a porcelain teacup with a bright smile beside a tiered tray of pastries.

data.promptProse: Under a sunlit pergola framed by fragrant citrus trees, Carlotta enjoys afternoon tea in a pastel rose organza dress and ribbon-trimmed sunhat, lifting a porcelain cup with a warm smile.
